failures.speaker: Torin
failures.excerpt: "Veranthos predates the public settlement," he said. "The Ruusan Reformations—the real ones, the ones in the history records—they came after the Seventh Battle. After the New Sith Wars ended. But this protocol—" He gestured at the display. "This was written before that."

failures.speaker: Sera
failures.excerpt: "The public Reformations were built to carry it," Ben said. The words came out before he had fully thought them, and he felt the shape of them as he spoke—the realization landing in his body before his mind had finished processing it. "The public settlement after Ruusan was real. But it carried a concealed layer underneath. The Veranthos protocol was the wound they buried so the public reforms could stand."

dialogue_lines.text: Gavran's personal archive. Access-coded to his senior staff.
Indexed by operational phase. The terms are—
They are what you would expect from a war that had already gone on too long.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Sera
dialogue_lines.text: Gavran standardized the protocol documentation in this register. It was not the common tongue even then.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Sera
dialogue_lines.text: That is what he called it.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: Private penance. Private containment. No public record. No institutional acknowledgment.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: Because it was a war crime,

dialogue_lines.speaker: Torin
dialogue_lines.text: The Ruusan Reformations—the real ones, the ones in the history records—they came after the Seventh Battle. After the New Sith Wars ended. But this protocol—

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: Then the Reformations did not create this. They inherited it.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Desh
dialogue_lines.text: The public record says the Reformations demilitarized the Jedi,

dialogue_lines.speaker: Desh
dialogue_lines.text: Ended the Lords, centralized training, bound the Order to Republic oversight. That is all true.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: I am pulling the public text now. It matches what you were taught.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: But they are not the whole story.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: Containment of the wound Gavran's technique created. And penance for the technique itself. The private penance was the price of the public reform.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: The public Reformations were built to carry it,

dialogue_lines.speaker: Sera
dialogue_lines.text: The public settlement after Ruusan was real. But it carried a concealed layer underneath. The Veranthos protocol was the wound they buried so the public reforms could stand.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Sera
dialogue_lines.text: We are going to need the rest of the archive,

dialogue_lines.speaker: Sera
dialogue_lines.text: The protocol language. The anchor allocations. Everything Gavran wrote about what he did and why.
